purpose: Gap G4 — ground BIM organic-drift bound (1.1%/day) + poisoning alarm (2.3%/day)
drift_metric: total-variation distance of daily service-mix distribution, %/day

organic_daily_drift_pct.reading: Raw day-over-day drift median = 5.39%/day — but this is DOMINATED by weekday/weekend seasonality (see deseasonalized below), not secular drift.

deseasonalized_drift.reading: After removing weekly seasonality, secular organic drift = 0.98%/day (vs the raw 5.39%/day). Cumulative drift vs Week-0 PLATEAUS (~22-28%), confirming bounded seasonal oscillation rather than runaway drift.

paper_threshold_check.verdict_1.1_bound: TOO LOW vs real organic drift
paper_threshold_check.verdict_2.3_alarm: false-positive-safe: 4.2% of organic days stay below it

cumulative_drift_vs_week0.reading: Baseline service-mix diverges from Week-0 by this much — the total organic movement the CUSUM monitor must tolerate without alarming.

abrupt_shifts.reading: Days whose day-over-day drift exceeds median+3*MAD — the abrupt seasonality shifts the CUSUM must NOT mistake for poisoning (cf. the Nature paper's Week-10 abrupt shift).
